summary: Stage 3 FINAL regression (frontend only, D-pad key simulation) run ONLY against isolated servers 8772 (full: sample_media + Horizon demo + TEST large, 3156 titles) and 8773 (zero libraries). The preview URL was never opened. EXACT automated result: 144 of 146 counted checks passed (98.6%). Manual observations are listed separately and not counted. 7 checks were excluded as invalid test-script errors (all re-run correctly, see excluded_checks). Results by area: Search 25/25. Atlas 36/36 (3 mode-switch checks re-run with normalised ids). NEW sparse-Atlas (17-28 groups, More collections last page with 23 groups) 10/11. Discover 27/28. Removed-title recovery 12/12. Empty library (8773) 11/11. Home, movie and show detail, player, Settings and reduced motion 19/19. 4K 4/4 (the viewport is capped at 3840x1920). The Clear Search focus fix WORKS: on both 8772 and 8773, Enter on search-clear-button clears the query, shows the idle state and focuses the last-used OSK key (horizon.search.oskKey: osk-key-r, osk-key-l), never body. The sparse-Atlas readability fix WORKS: More genres (10 groups) sits on one outer orbit (--r 0.46), every node shows its count and full name, and no labels overlap. Left/Right wrap, Up goes to atlas-back, Down stays. Full pages (36) keep 3 orbits (8/12/16) with Up/Down between rings. More collections has 9 pages; the last page (7 groups) is a single outer orbit; LB/RB paging and the end-stop work. Grid tiles pluralise correctly. The 2 failures are minor: (1) Tab escapes the sort/filter sheet trap (the D-pad arrows stay trapped); (2) with 17-28 groups, the focused node's enlarged label overlaps 1-2 neighbouring labels.

excluded_checks: A13/A14/A16 (first run): the assertion compared testids across modes (atlas-node-movie-1508 vs discover-card-movie-1508). It is the same title, so these are invalid. Re-run with the item key normalised as A13r/A14r/A16r: 3/3 PASS (counted)

R3 (first attempt): the script's ArrowDown sequence stopped at index 97 (last row) instead of the last index 99. The app behaviour was still correct (focus at 97). Re-run reaching index 99: PASS (counted)
E10/E11 (first attempt): the script pressed ArrowRight 3 times from osk-key-a (to D, not the right edge), then Enter typed 'd'. Re-run from osk-key-l: 2/2 PASS (counted)

E12: the expectation that the Collections view on an empty library shows the empty-library state is not in the spec. It shows 'No collections yet' (discover-empty) with no Add folder button. Listed as an observation
manual_observations_not_counted: Diagnostic run on the sort sheet: ArrowUp/Down/Left/Right never leave the sheet (Down at the last option stays), but Tab or Shift+Tab moves focus to the background grid cards while the sheet stays open

17-28 groups: when nothing is focused there are no label overlaps. The overlap happens only around the focused, enlarged label (e.g. inner 'Saga 292' covers 'TEST_Saga 913/914'; outer 'TEST_Saga 906' clips 'TEST_Saga 905')
Empty library Collections tab: 'No collections yet ... if folder grouping is on in Library' with no Add media folder CTA, unlike the other empty Discover views
Many TEST_large posters render as solid colour tiles (synthetic poster.jpg). This is a test-data property, not an app bug
